title: Software Engineer 5_India
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (Messaging & Microservices)
Experience Level: 10+ Years
Location: India-BLR

Seeking a talented Software Engineer to architect, develop, implement, test, and maintain robust business and software applications tailored for specialized data engineering pipelines. This role encompasses full-stack responsibilities, involving both backend and frontend development to ensure seamless, efficient, and scalable system performance.

Job Responsibilities:
• Fine-tune and improve a variety of sophisticated software implementation projects.
• Gather and analyze system requirements, document specifications, and develop software solutions to meet client needs and data.
• Analyze and review enhancement requests and specifications.
• Implement system software and customize to client requirements.
• Prepare detailed software specifications and test plans.
• Code new programs to client specifications and create test data for testing.
• Modify existing programs to new standards and conduct unit testing of developed programs.
• Create migration packages for system testing, user testing, and implementation.
• Provide quality assurance reviews.
• Perform post-implementation validation of software and resolve any bugs found during testing.
Technical Skills Required:
• Programming Languages & Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot
• Architecture & Design: Microservices, RESTful APIs
• Messaging Systems: Experience with messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ)
• Databases: RDBMS, SQL
• Testing: Unit Testing, Cucumber Framework
• Development Practices: Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, Git
Professional Attributes:
• Ability to work with ambiguity in requirements and proactively drive clarification.
• Methodical and structured approach to problem-solving and development.
• Highly responsive, available, and reliable in team collaboration.
• Strong work ethic and ownership of deliverables.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 10+ years of experience in backend software development.
• Solid foundation in computer science, including data structures, algorithms, and software design.
• Proven experience in large systems software design and development.
• Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across new and legacy systems.
• Experience with problem diagnosis and resolution in production environments

title: Software Engineer 3_India
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer


Role summary
We are seeking a Data Engineer with deep experience building reliable, high-throughput data pipelines using PySpark Structured Streaming, batch PySpark, AWS, and Databricks. You will design, implement, and operate streaming and batch ETL that feed our data lake and analytics platforms, drive data quality improvements, and produce clear technical documentation for operational teams.

Key responsibilities:

Spark Structured Streaming:
Design and develop production streaming applications using PySpark Structured Streaming.
Integrate with streaming sources such as Kafka, Kinesis, Event Hub, and similar systems.
Parse and process JSON payloads at scale.
Implement serverless logic where appropriate using AWS Lambda.
Deploy and operate streaming workloads on Databricks when applicable, leveraging Databricks job scheduling and cluster management.

Batch applications:
Build and maintain batch ETL pipelines using PySpark on Databricks and/or AWS compute.
Improve data quality through validation, monitoring, and automated remediation.

Lake catalog and SQL analytics:
Manage S3 layout and partitioning to support efficient reads and cost-aware storage.
Integrate Kinesis Data Firehose for durable delivery into the data lake.
Use AWS Glue jobs and crawlers to maintain an accurate Data Catalog and support Athena queries.
Support Athena-based analysis and reporting, collaborating with Analytics on workgroups, cost controls, and governance.
Leverage Databricks features such as Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks SQL to support governed, performant analytics and ACID-compliant pipelines.

title: Developer - Specialty 5_India
description:
Position Summary - 10years+ exposure
We are seeking a skilled Software Developer – Interoperability to design, build, and support healthcare interfaces using the InterSystems IRIS for Health Interoperability platform. This role will focus on the development, testing, validation, and support of clinical and administrative integrations, with an emphasis on lab systems, orders, and results.
The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills, working closely with application teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, standards-based integrations that support patient care and operational efficiency.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Interoperability & Interface Development
• Design, develop, and maintain healthcare interfaces using InterSystems IRIS for Health Interoperability
• Implement and support interfaces using healthcare standards, including:
o HL7 v2.x
o ASTM
o EDI-based lab orders and results
o FHIR (preferred, not required)
• Leverage IRIS Interoperability components such as:
o Business Services, Business Processes, and Business Operations
o Data Transformations (DTL)
o Routing, orchestration, and error-handling patterns aligned with IRIS best practices
• Develop using modern ObjectScript patterns and conventions (not legacy MUMPS-style coding)
Development & Engineering Practices
• Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following modern software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum, CI/CD concepts, version control)
• Use SQL effectively for data access, reporting, and troubleshooting within IRIS
• Participate in code reviews and adhere to internal development standards and integration patterns
• Create and maintain technical documentation for interfaces, mappings, and workflows
System Integration & Collaboration
• Collaborate with internal application teams, vendors, and external partners to:
o Gather interface requirements
o Define message specifications
o Map data and validate workflows
• Support interface testing, validation, and go-live activities across multiple environments
• Troubleshoot and resolve interface issues, including data quality, transmission failures, and workflow defects
• Assist with production support, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement
________________________________________
Required Qualifications
Technical Skills
• Hands-on experience with InterSystems IRIS for Health, specifically the Interoperability platform
• Strong proficiency in ObjectScript, using modern development techniques
• Deep working knowledge of:
o HL7 v2.x messaging
o ASTM standards
o Interface workflows for lab orders, results, and acknowledgments
• Solid understanding of SQL within InterSystems environments
• Familiarity with interface engine concepts such as message queues, retries, acknowledgments, and error handling
Healthcare & Domain Knowledge
• Experience working with laboratory systems, including:
o Lab orders (ORM)
o Results reporting (ORU)
o Reference ranges, units, and test catalogs
• Understanding of healthcare workflows, data integrity, and regulatory considerations
• Experience with EHR/EIS/LIS integrations is strongly preferred
Communication & Collaboration
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Proven ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
• Strong collaboration skills; comfortable working across multiple teams and disciplines
• Ability to manage priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced healthcare IT environment
________________________________________
Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications
• Experience with FHIR APIs and modern healthcare integration patterns
• Experience integrating with or developing applications using:
o Java (Spring / Spring Boot)
o Angular
• Familiarity with RESTful APIs and JSON-based message formats
• Experience with source control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines
• Prior experience in clinical integration, interface engines, or health information exchange (HIE) environments
• InterSystems certifications (IRIS, Interoperability, or HealthShare-related)
